assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

On OpenCode 2.x there is no agent launch to time: one long-lived `serve --service` hosts every session, and an API client creates a session over POST /api/session. The daemon's 2.x reader admits a session when its first session_message activity lands (watcher_v2.go, P3 #2107), so the scenario's start is the first prompt, and the session is first seen in working, not ready (P4's sampler; P5a's three smoke recordings all begin `new session created` → working). The PID half holds as specified: the session binds to the one running service (pid.go servicePIDFor) within milliseconds of its admission (P5a's 2-20: transcript_new 01:50:33.298, pid_discovered .411).

## Spec choices

- Birth is a ses_… transcript_new; pid_discovered on the same session within 1000ms of it (the scenario's 'PID bound within 1s').
- 'Appears in ready' is the post-turn ready: the turn ends on the plugin's Stop hook and the session settles in ready (topology working → ready on 2.x, because birth is the first prompt's activity).
caveats: A service-hosted session has no launch of its own, so 'ready within 1s of agent launch' is not measurable on 2.x; the spec pins the PID bind and the settle instead.
Recorded with #2120 (P5-0) in the daemon: the hook-ended ready carries no ready → working → ready bounce; the PR checks the raw events for it.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service; OwnsSharedPID answers false for an archived row
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
P4 QA run on the sandbox service: S1 working → ready, S2 working → waiting → ready, S3 interrupted → ready, all on the service pid

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
One trivial turn, then 4s so the daemon's final transitions flush

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok

verify: a ses_… transcript_new for the API session
pid_discovered binds it to the service pid within 1s
working, then the plugin's Stop hook_received and ready
